query: deep32 handshake probe: which router translates type-7 LSAs
documents: The NSSA ABR with the highest router ID translates type-7 LSAs into type-5 LSAs.
OSPF hello packets are sent every ten seconds on broadcast networks.
BGP local preference is shared inside one autonomous system.
A type-7 LSA is flooded only inside the NSSA that originated it.
recorded: production hub via Tailscale Serve, record_gpu_probes.py
